chunks: They want you to hasten the punishment: But for a time already determined the punishment would have come upon them. It will come upon them all too suddenly, and they will be caught unawares.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the 'appointed time' for divine punishment in Surah Al-Ankabut?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine wisdom behind the delay of punishment, illustrating that God's patience is not a sign of weakness but a deliberate postponement until the appointed term (ajal musamma). It emphasizes that the retribution will descend suddenly (baghtatan) upon those who remain heedless, reinforcing the concept that divine justice is inevitable and perfectly timed.
